answer: Bind each agent to a hardware timing fingerprint: every epoch it must sign a microbenchmark signature only its own silicon produces, and a rotating jury splits that signal through a prism of independent timing probes. Clones crammed on one machine emit near-identical fingerprints and collapse onto a single narrow ledge, flagged at once and slashed. You cannot forge a distinct signature without distinct hardware, so N fakes demand N real machines: linear N-times capital and power, paid every epoch.
